statement: let w (k : ℕ) := if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k : ℝ) else 0; let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let S (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (w k : ℂ) * E ((k : ℝ)*t); let Q (n : ℕ) := (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs (n : ℕ) := {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let f (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) := (S n t)^2 * E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let major (n : ℕ) := intervalIntegral ((arcs n).indicator (f n)) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let minor (n : ℕ) := intervalIntegral ((arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (f n)) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ (B : ℕ) (c : ℝ), 4 ≤ B → 0 < c → (∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → n ≤ B → Even n → 0 < Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun p => w p * w (n - p))) → (∀ n : ℕ, B < n → Even n → c * (n : ℝ) ≤ (major n).re) → (∀ n : ℕ, B < n → Even n → -(c / 2 * (n : ℝ)) ≤ (minor n).re) → ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → Even n → let w : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k : ℝ) else 0; 0 < Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun p => w p * w (n - p))

plain_statement.en: Finite positivity through B and signed major- and minor-arc floors above B imply positive prime-log convolution at every even n ≥ 4.
plain_statement.zh: 若已验证截至 B 的卷积正性，且在 B 以上有带符号的主弧、次弧下界，则对每个 n ≥ 4 的偶数，素数对数权卷积均为正。

brief.en: The two masked integrals recover the exact prime convolution by Fourier orthogonality. Above B their real parts sum to at least cn/2, and the finite premise includes B.
brief.zh: 由傅里叶正交性，两个带掩膜的积分相加恰好还原素数权卷积。在 B 以上二者实部之和至少为 cn/2，端点 B 则由有限范围的假设覆盖。
